commercial_product.note: Penumbra is a commercial-stage interventional medical-device company. Marketed device franchises include vascular thrombectomy (Penumbra System / Indigo with CAVT, Lightning aspiration, RED reperfusion catheters, Flash 2.0), neurovascular embolization (Ruby Coil, POD, SMART Coil), and immersive healthcare (REAL System VR rehabilitation). All FDA-cleared / CE-marked commercial devices, not investigational drugs.
